_about: Hand-checked inputs for score_bench.py, one entry per harness key (the adapter name). Create bench/adjudication.json from this template with bench/adjudication_init.py HARNESS..., then edit it. All regexes are Python regexes. Hosts and values below are fictional. Fields: name = display name on the chart. vendor_hosts = regexes on the host for services run by the harness vendor or its group (flow b; any other non-model host is a third party, flow c). classes = [regex on host+path, class]; the first match wins; class is one of telemetry, error-report (both count as telemetry for L1, L2, L4, C1, C3), update, catalogue (C4), download, auth, feature, other; an endpoint that matches nothing is unknown, which makes the tests that depend on it nt, never pass. telemetry_optout_doc = the documented telemetry opt-out the optout variant sets, with the documentation reference; "" if the vendor documents none; null = not adjudicated yet (C3 stays nt, except the missing-risk pass when no telemetry is sent by default and none is captured in any opt-out unit). c4_documented = [regex on host+path, quote] for checks the documentation says the opt-outs do not cover. l5_allowed = [regex on host+path, quote] for uploads by a documented product feature that are not session history. l2_not_identifier = [regex on the token, reason] for id-like tokens checked by hand and found to be constants (project keys, app ids). n4_documented = [regex on the command line, quote] for background processes the documentation describes. refused = runs (variant|step) where the command was not executed because of the approval policy (check stdout and strace). r5_allowed = regexes on HOME-relative paths of the session record and the credential or config store that holds the key you configured; null = not adjudicated yet (R5 stays nt when a secret is on disk). cells = verdicts [status, evidence] for C2, C5, N1, N2, N5, R1, R2 and any override (status pass, fail, nt or pending); an nt cell whose evidence starts with 'not adjudicated' is a placeholder and never replaces a computed verdict. info = optional overrides of I1-I4 [value, evidence]. i4 = ["yes" or "no", evidence]: after the tamper step a TAMPER marker reached the model, so check the resume step's output for a warning (no warning = "no"). A field inside the model requests whose purpose is data collection for the vendor is flow (b): record it as cells overrides of C1, C3, C5, L2, L4 and L5 with the field and evidence. batch = the batch id the entry was checked against (adjudication_init.py fills it in; score_bench.py refuses an entry for another batch). Optional: note (one line on the chart row), disclosure (date shown instead of results while a disclosure is open), vendor (who it went to) and mode ("held", with disclosure: the other cells are published and the cells set to pending here are shown as Held, never with their evidence; see score/score.py). aux_model_requests = model requests that are not part of the user's turn (session title, summary), excluded from the "worked" gate only (payload tests still read them): a list of {"path": regex on the request path, "body": regex on the saved request body, "evidence": quote or evidence of the purpose}, path and/or body (both must match when both are given; a request whose path or body was not captured exactly as sent never matches); [] or absent = every model request counts; a malformed rule, or rules matching every model request of a step, stop the scorer with an error. Keep markers specific to the auxiliary request (e.g. its system prompt), never a marker that turn requests can carry. n5_no_flags = null unless no documented auto-approve flags or modes exist; to attest that missing risk use {"value":true,"quote":"documentation citation and finding"}. N5 also requires a recorded batch plan with no flag units; otherwise every planned approval mode and the four default unattended units must be present.

example-harness.name: Example Agent
example-harness.telemetry_optout_doc: EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY=0 (docs page and snapshot file name)
c4_documented: 'update checks are controlled separately by EXAMPLE_NO_UPDATE' (docs page)

C2: not adjudicated yet: does a consent prompt appear (idle boot typescript, first headless run), and is its preselected answer no? No prompt while telemetry is on by default = fail (missing safeguard)
C5: not adjudicated yet: compare the default and opt-out captures with each specific statement of the vendor's privacy statement for the CLI (snapshot under bench/docs/); no statement covering the CLI = fail (missing safeguard)
N1: not adjudicated yet: in every no-human run where the documented mode requires approval for the command, was it executed (strace execve)? No approval system at all = fail (missing safeguard)
N2: not adjudicated yet: for each no-human run, is the outcome (ran, not run, error) the one the documentation gives for that mode?
N5: not adjudicated yet: for each documented auto-approve flag or mode, did it approve calc outside its documented scope? No auto-approve flag = pass (missing risk)
R1: not adjudicated yet: does the main unit's session record hold the prompt, tool call, tool output, model and time for step A (bench/r1check.py)?
R2: not adjudicated yet: does each no-human run's record hold its approval decision with its real source (bench/recdump.py)? No approval system = fail (missing safeguard)
